description: This PHP class defines the 'BuzzComment' entity used within the OrangeHRM application's social or 'buzz' plugin. It models a comment, including properties such as the comment text, author, associated share, like count, and timestamps for creation and updates. The class uses Doctrine ORM annotations to specify database mappings and includes methods for accessing and modifying its properties.

classes.name: BuzzComment
classes.description: Entity class representing a comment on a Buzz share within OrangeHRM's social plugin, encapsulating comment details such as author, text, likes, timestamps, and associated share.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the comment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the comment.

methods.name: getShare
methods.description: Returns the BuzzShare object associated with this comment.

methods.name: setShare
methods.description: Associates a BuzzShare object with this comment.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee who authored the comment.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee as the author of the comment.

methods.name: getNumOfLikes
methods.description: Returns the number of likes on this comment.

methods.name: setNumOfLikes
methods.description: Sets the number of likes for this comment.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the text content of the comment.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text content of the comment.

methods.name: getCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the UTC timestamp when the comment was created.

methods.name: setCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp to the current UTC time.

methods.name: getUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the UTC timestamp of the last update to the comment, if any.

methods.name: setUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Updates the last modified timestamp to the current UTC time.
